items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Adds FDA Vision Warning To GLP 1 Drug Labels
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) and Novo Nordisk plan to add new FDA required warning labels to GLP-1 drugs tied to rare vision risks. The updated labels will reference non arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, or NAION, a serious but uncommon eye condition. The FDA label change affects GLP-1 treatments used in both obesity and diabetes care, tightening risk disclosure for prescribers and patients.
